text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We ultimately decide to compete in an international G1 race, and the three of us get ready to depart for our trip.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Moments before boarding, however, Agnes Tachyon reminds us of the significant risks we'll be taking with the G1 race and presses me with a question—should I really let Manhattan Cafe compete abroad?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After weighing our goal of pursuing Manhattan Cafe's friend against her own well-being, I rescind my decision to let her compete abroad.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Regardless, Manhattan Cafe still plans on traveling alone. Affected by the concerns of those who believe in her, she finds herself unable to take a single step…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we cancel our plans to go abroad and make the Takarazuka Kinen our new goal.
